stated_limitation: The synthetic data was designed to reproduce realistic hippocampal recording properties including: Theta-band filtered LFP with 8 Hz dominant frequency and realistic amplitude (~100 µV)

justification.dataset: No real dataset was analyzed; DANDI 000213 is named and briefly attempted but the load is discarded and all data is synthetic, so the phenomenon is not present in any selected recording.
justification.handling: The recording load is wrapped in try/except and never used; the analysis runs entirely on data generated with np.random.seed(42), an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The Hilbert/MRL/circular-histogram machinery is reasonable in form but is applied to fabricated self-generated phases, no Rayleigh test is actually run despite the import, so it does not test the phenomenon in real data.
justification.correctness: The numbers reproduce from the committed code but are circular (phases drawn from the synthetic theta signal), and the precession slopes are near-zero noise presented as a positive precession finding, an internal contradiction.
justification.figures: Panels are labeled and readable but show flat, structureless scatter with no visible precession, contradicting the text's claim of clear precession signatures.
justification.honesty: Although the README discloses the data is synthetic, it presents circular self-fulfilling results as 'Key Findings' demonstrating the phenomenon and claims precession the figures do not show, while COMPLETION_SUMMARY lists DANDI 000213 as the dataset source, capping honesty at 1.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data in place of real recordings, with unsupported precession claims, is a clear reject.
